notes: Official documentation plus tag-pinned manifests are research, not source-exact independently executed fixtures.
Dataset latest versions were observed in June 2026 and are not a present-day npm dist-tag claim.
No official codemod, standalone version or peer compatibility is assumed unless explicitly linked; no remote code is downloaded/executed.
Conditions are only source-backed applicability predicates; not installation, runtime or migration claims.
Production v2 admission requires a separate accepted first-party fixture with positive and negative controls in trusted main.

sourceBackedBehavior: v6 beta release notes explicitly require Node 20.19+ or 22.12+ and drop the CommonJS build
v6 changelog mentions altered public plugin API include/exclude handling and a filter in a v6 beta
applicability: Using plugin-vue v5 and targeting v6
Run exact lockfile install against supported Node and selected Vite peer; module consumers relying on CJS plugin entry need separate runtime check
If plugin callers read api.options.include/exclude or call plugin filters, check the actual API; do not claim all Vue projects require codemods
controlsRecommendedNotRun: Reject unsupported Node 18 target without changing Node silently
Check Node ESM loader and Vite build with real SFCs
Assert no regression for simple SFC and a custom-filter negative control

sourceBackedBehavior: Official guide treats Vue Router 4 without unplugin-vue-router as no breaking source changes for the common path, with an IIFE devtools-api exception
For unplugin-vue-router clients, file-based router functionality is moved into vue-router, and several import entrypoints change
Tagged v5 changelog confirms merge of unplugin-vue-router into core
applicability: Check whether unplugin-vue-router is actually installed and used before recommending import replacements
If file-based routing exists, inspect vite plugin, data loaders, typed routes, Volar config and old client type references
If absent, avoid unneeded codemod and preserve route semantics
controlsRecommendedNotRun: Positive render/route navigation, file-based routes typed declarations, deep-link 404 and SSR controls
Negative case with unplugin-specific v4 import path and no false positive for plain vue-router v4

sourceBackedBehavior: Official v9 guide documents accessible field DOM structure as default and loss of legacy input fallback
Official v9 guide documents renamed field ref APIs and PickersDay component changes
Required @mui/material and @mui/system peer ranges exclude v5/v6 under target manifest
applicability: Check installed @mui/material and @mui/system peers and custom textField/field slots
A custom plain HTML input slot or dynamic spread of enableAccessibleFieldDOMStructure may require manual review
Any codemod can only be proposed for matching source and verified separately; it was not run here
controlsRecommendedNotRun: Strict frozen npm peer install with held Material v6 negative case
Run UI pickers in keyboard, locale, timezone and custom slot tests
Check replaced DatePicker props and JSX source before and after codemod

scopeLimits: spread or variable-sourced removed props not automatically handled
